metadata.no_hallucinations_policy: Every blank (null) unconfirmed field, conflicting on-page specification, vermeil keyword trap, and restrictive seller return/reputation finding is surfaced here with its official source URL rather than guessed or hidden. Per COORDINATION.md, needs_review items are published transparently on Flagged for Review and do not block merge.

flagged_items.subject: Mejuri — Daily Stacker Ring (18k Gold Vermeil — DISQUALIFIED CONTROL)
flagged_items.finding: DISQUALIFIED BY CHECKLIST CHK-02 (Not Solid Gold): Included as an anti-hallucination / keyword-trap control case because the page text contains the substring '18k solid gold' inside 'a thick layer of 18k solid gold plated on 91% recycled sterling silver'. Base metal is 92.5% silver, not solid karat gold. | XRF testing alert (ISO 23345:2021): 2.5 µm 18K gold electroplate over Ag925 will show strong Ag K-alpha fluorescence and surface Au distortion on ED-XRF — demonstrating why XRF immediately catches vermeil misrepresented as solid gold.
flagged_items.buyer_or_reviewer_action: Walk away: fails solid karat gold requirement (vermeil plating or unresolved 9K/10K conflict).

flagged_items.subject: VRAI (CAUTION / HIGH RISK — BBB 'F' Rating & $300 Recycling Fee on Certain Cash Refunds)
flagged_items.finding: CRITICAL SELLER REPUTATION FLAG (CHK-05): BBB Los Angeles profile rates Vrai 'F' due to 'Failure to respond to 5 complaint(s) filed against business'. | CRITICAL RETURN FEE FLAG (CHK-07): $300 USD recycling fee deducted on setting-only or engraved engagement ring returns to original payment method (pushing buyers into non-refundable store credit). | Exact list of accepted credit card networks was not present in static HTML fetched from VRAI policy snippets; left null/unverified.
flagged_items.buyer_or_reviewer_action: Publishes exact gram weights (e.g., 2.3g, 2.86g, 3.5g at size 6), ideal for post-arrival scale checks. However, third-party alteration voids returns — use strictly non-destructive XRF and confirm fee-free cash refund eligibility in writing before ordering.

flagged_items.subject: Mejuri (CONDITIONAL — Solid 14K Line Only (Skip Complimentary Engraving; Request Gram Weight))
flagged_items.finding: Complimentary engraving trap: free optional engraving renders $1,500 rings non-returnable. | Catalog mixes 14k Solid Gold rings and 18k Gold Vermeil (sterling silver core) rings whose descriptions contain the phrase 'layer of 18k solid gold plated on 91% recycled sterling silver'. | Does not publish gram weights on ring product pages.
flagged_items.buyer_or_reviewer_action: 30-day free return from delivery supports independent jeweler scale + ED-XRF verification as long as ring is unengraved and unworn. Verify product is from '14k Solid Gold' line and NOT '18k Gold Vermeil'.

flagged_items.subject: Local Eclectic (CAUTION — Short 14-Day Cash Refund Window, Missing Gram Weights & 9K/10K Copy Conflict)
flagged_items.finding: RETURN WINDOW TRAP (CHK-07): Headline states 'Returns are accepted within 90 days', but cash refunds expire 14 days after delivery (days 15–90 yield store credit only), and return shipping is deducted. | Customer service phone number is omitted on official Contact Us page (only found via BBB Chicago profile: 888-232-8306). | Live product page 'Solid Gold Simple Knot Ring' mixes '9k Solid Gold' (below US 10K standard) and '10k solid yellow gold' on the same page. | Specific accepted credit card brands were not enumerated on the fetched static FAQ/Contact pages; left null/unverified.
flagged_items.buyer_or_reviewer_action: Tight 14-day cash-refund cutoff means independent jeweler scale + XRF verification must be completed within ~10 days of delivery to avoid being locked into store credit. Pay special attention to 9K vs 10K alloy content.

flagged_items.subject: Menē (CAUTION — Strict 7-Day Window & Up to 10% Discretionary Cash-Refund Restocking Fee)
flagged_items.finding: STRICT 7-DAY RETURN & FEE WARNING (CHK-07 / CHK-12): Sep 2, 2026 Terms of Service allow Menē to deduct up to a 10% restocking fee on discretionary original-payment-method refunds, while self-service 7-day returns issue non-cash Menē Credit subject to expiry. | Missing Certificate of Authenticity triggers an additional 5% assessment deduction. | Pure 24K gold (99.99% Au) is physically softer than 14K/18K alloys for prong-set gemstone rings (Menē sells plain 24K bands/rings without prong-set gemstones).
flagged_items.buyer_or_reviewer_action: Each 24K piece ships with a Certificate of Authenticity stating final gram weight (in-stock ±0.5g, Crafted-on-Demand ±1.0g). Perform 0.01g scale + 24K XRF check on Day 1–2 of arrival due to strict 7-day return window, and keep Certificate of Authenticity intact to avoid 5% fee.
